# srd-masum-r35b

Live at https://srd-masum-r35b.folkapps.com. Vite + React + Tailwind, compiled and deployed as a static bundle by folk after your session exits. The global rules in `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` apply here too.

Only a `create_or_edit_app` run publishes. Editing, building or committing these files from a terminal never changes the live site.

## Data

No database. Persist with `localStorage` (JSON.parse/stringify for complex objects). Forms use `mailto:`, an external form service, or a confirmation state — there is no backend.

## Design contract

<!-- Owned by the build, not by folk. Later edits read this to stay on-system,
     so be specific: a vague contract guarantees drift. -->

**Theme.** Dark is the default. A sun/moon icon button in the nav toggles to a light theme (`html.light`); the choice is stored in `localStorage` under `srd-theme` and applied by an inline script in `index.html` before first paint. Neutral tokens are CSS variables (`--canvas`, `--raised`, `--sunk`, `--hairline`, `--ink`, `--muted`, `--faint`) defined in `src/index.css`, so Tailwind classes like `bg-canvas` follow the theme. The accent `#ff64c8` stays the same in both themes; text on accent uses `text-on-accent` (`#0e0d0c`). Light values: canvas `#faf8f5`, raised `#ffffff`, sunk `#f0ede8`, hairline `#e0dbd4`, ink `#161411`, muted `#5c5751`.

**Tokens (dark).** Canvas `#0e0d0c` (page), raised `#171614` (contact panel), sunk `#1f1d1b` (nav pill, footer, players), hairline `#2c2a27`, ink `#f4f1ea`, muted `#a39e98`, the single accent `#ff64c8` (CTAs, links, focus, the record mark). Display: Archivo Black (`@fontsource/archivo-black`, tracking -0.04em). Body: DM Sans 400/500/700 (`@fontsource/dm-sans`). Utility: IBM Plex Mono 400/500 for eyebrows (`@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono`). Layout: single column, max-w-6xl, sections separated by hairline rules, 16:9 YouTube embeds. The Videos section is a swipeable carousel (touch swipe and mouse drag, scroll-snap per card, layoutId dot indicators below); other sections use responsive grids. Signature element: the hero's oversized name whose two words rise in one by one, over a dimmed hero photograph (`/images/hero-portrait.jpg`, object-top) under a canvas-tinted vertical gradient overlay (`from-canvas/60 via-canvas/75 to-canvas/95`). This gradient is the one deliberate exception to the no-gradients rule. The Spotify "Follow on Spotify" button is the other exception: brand-mandated Spotify green `#1DB954`. The New Release countdown target is the `RELEASE_DATE` constant at the top of `App.jsx`; footer social links come from `SOCIAL_LINKS` in `src/data/videos.js`. Nav logo: a round pixel-art avatar (`/images/avatar.jpg`, 34px, accent ring) followed by the "SRD Masum" wordmark. The favicon is also `/images/avatar.jpg`.

**Simplicity.** Up front: the name, tagline, the featured player, the video grid and the email. Nothing is behind a menu. The only transient surface is the contact "Copy email" button, which changes its own label in place (no tray). No trays exist yet; any future overlay should be a bottom sheet on mobile and a centered dialog above `sm`, opening from the button that triggered it.

**Fluidity.** Shared spring: `{ type: "spring", stiffness: 260, damping: 30, mass: 0.9 }`, exported from `src/components/Reveal.jsx`. `layoutId="nav-pill"` in `src/components/Nav.jsx` travels between the three section links as scroll-spy moves the active state. Hero words rise with staggered springs. Section content reveals on scroll with `whileInView`. The "Copy email" label morphs via an AnimatePresence `popLayout` swap of the inner span (copy ↔ copied). Reduced motion: opacity-only entrances, no travel, no tap scale on the hero.

**Delight.** Tier 1 (constant use): the nav pill glides between sections; buttons spring on press (scale 0.97). Tier 2: the video grid staggers in by column, the copy button springs and vibrates on copy. Tier 3 (rare, one moment): the hero name rising word by word on first load. Hidden surprise: none yet, keep it that way until a clear moment earns one. Music visualizer: while the cover track in Songs plays, a soft pink glow behind the hero photo (`src/components/HeroGlow.jsx`) swells with the bass, read from a shared Web Audio analyser (`src/lib/beat.js`). It stops on pause and is off under prefers-reduced-motion. Keep confetti off this page; the page has no finishing moment.
